content: द्वारम् [द्वृ-णिच्-अच् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A door, gateway, gate. .²2 A passage, entrance, ingress, opening; अथवा कृतवाग्द्वारे वंशेऽस्मिन् <ls>R. 1. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 18</ls>. .²3 An aperture of the human body (they are nine); see खम् and <ls>Ku. 3. 50</ls>; <ls>Bg. 8. 12</ls>; and <ls>Ms. 6. 48</ls> also; द्वारि द्वाराणि शेषाणि <ls>Sāṅ. K. 35</ls>. .²4 Way, medium, means (द्वारेण ‘through’, ‘by means of’; <ls>Pt. 1.</ls>). .{@-री@} A door.
